name: The Golem's Seal
author: Antigravity CTF Team
description: Doctor Doom's cybernetic Golem Legion guards the Sub-Quantum Collider using a post-quantum identification protocol over polynomial ring R_q = Z_257[x]/(x^8 + 1). Doom claims Stark Industries' quantum computers cannot break it. However, the rejection sampler PRNG leaks high-order entropy in masking polynomial y(x). Harvest identification transcripts, solve the resulting Hidden Number Problem on the lattice to recover the secret signing polynomial s(x), and forge a disarm token.
